items.name: Service tier
items.howToStart: Agree the tier with the Service Transition Manager.

items.name: Support model
items.howToStart: Describe first, second and third line support.

items.name: Service hours and availability plan
items.howToStart: Set service hours and the availability target.

items.name: Service runbook
items.howToStart: Write it in the service repository.

items.name: Knowledge articles for the service desk
items.howToStart: Draft one article per common request.

items.name: Dependencies and integrations
items.howToStart: List every system the service reads from or writes to.

items.name: Monitoring and alerting
items.howToStart: Set up dashboards and alerts on CDP.

items.name: Backup and recovery
items.howToStart: Confirm what CDP backs up and test a restore.

items.name: Data protection impact assessment
items.howToStart: Link to the assessment approved in alpha.

items.name: Whole life costs
items.howToStart: Link to the full business case.

items.name: Security assurance pack
items.howToStart: Start the pack with the security team.

items.name: Licensing
items.howToStart: List any licences the service depends on.

items.name: IT health check report
items.howToStart: Give the pen test supplier 6 to 8 weeks' notice.
items.template: None. The supplier provides the report.

items.name: Security operations centre onboarding
items.howToStart: Ask the security team.

items.name: Accessibility audit report and statement
items.howToStart: Book the audit 6 to 8 weeks ahead.

items.name: Platform Readiness Review
items.howToStart: Book the review in #cdp-support.

items.name: Service desk training
items.howToStart: Arrange a session with the service desk.

items.name: MyIT catalogue entry
items.howToStart: Raise the request in MyIT.

items.name: Change request
items.howToStart: Raise it about 10 days before release.

items.name: Early life support plan
items.howToStart: Agree who supports the service in its first weeks.

items.name: Closure report
items.howToStart: Write it after the last release.

items.name: Service acceptance sign-off
items.howToStart: The service owner signs the pack off.

items.name: Service operations guide in MyIT
items.howToStart: The pack is renamed and loaded into MyIT.

items.name: Lessons learned
items.howToStart: Run a retrospective with the governance teams.
